# Project Presentation Checklist

## Student
- [ ] Project brief is complete.
- [ ] Workspace has all required files.
- [ ] Workflow runs on demo data.
- [ ] Output sample is ready.
- [ ] At least 3 PDCA loops are logged.
- [ ] Sensitive data is removed or anonymized.
- [ ] Fallback screenshots/output are ready.
- [ ] Prepared to explain 2 design decisions and their trade-offs.
- [ ] Prepared to talk about 1 time the system failed and how you handled it.

## Instructor
- [ ] Rubric is open.
- [ ] Timing rule is clear.
- [ ] Demo order is set.
- [ ] Backup activity exists if live tool fails.

## Presentation Flow
1. Problem and outcome.
2. Workspace structure.
3. Live run.
4. Output review.
5. PDCA improvements.
6. What to improve next.
